heroSummary: The first day of the GCPS 2026–27 school year was Wednesday, August 5, 2026, and the last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Fall Break is October 12–16, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 4, and Spring Break is April 5–9. Students return from Winter Break on Tuesday, January 5. GCPS also schedules three at-home Digital Learning Days and separate early-release dates for grades K–8 and high school exams.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCPS Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: The GCPS Student Calendar lists Winter Break from December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027, and students return Tuesday, January 5. The detailed School-Year Calendar identifies January 4 as a teacher planning and staff development day and student holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Do GCPS students go to school on Digital Learning Days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. All students learn from home on the planned Digital Learning Days: September 18, November 3, and March 19. The Student Calendar labels November 3 as Election Day / Digital Learning Day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are GCPS early-release dates the same for every grade level?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Grades K–8 release 2½ hours early for parent-teacher conferences on October 28–29 and March 3–4. High schools have exam early-release windows on December 16–18 and May 24–26.

calendarFaqs.q: Does GCPS publish translated calendars for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. GCPS publishes Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese editions of the approved detailed calendar. The district currently says translations of the newer Student Grid Calendar are coming soon.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check for GCPS calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official GCPS calendar page and your school's announcements for the latest schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the GCPS school calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Download the MySchoolDates 2026–27 ICS file and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. This is a one-time import and will not update automatically if GCPS revises its calendar.

yearNumbers.label: Student Days
yearNumbers.detail: The official 2026–27 GCPS calendar lists 180 student days.

groups.label: Students learn from home
items: All students learn from home on September 18, November 3, and March 19. November 3 is Election Day / Digital Learning Day.

groups.label: Early release depends on grade level
items: Students in grades K–8 are dismissed 2½ hours early for parent-teacher conferences on October 28–29 and March 3–4.
High schools release early for exams on December 16–18 and May 24–26.

groups.label: When students return
items: Students return after Fall Break on October 19, after Thanksgiving Break on November 30, after Winter Break on January 5, and after Spring Break on April 12.
The Student Calendar includes January 4 in Winter Break; the detailed calendar labels that Monday as a teacher planning and staff development day and student holiday.

groups.label: School-specific schedules
items: Check your school's calendar for bell schedules, testing, athletics, graduation events, and campus-specific changes.

customSections.label: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
customSections.content: Compared with 2025–26, GCPS starts one day later and ends six days later. Fall Break also moves later in October, and the district schedules three Digital Learning Days instead of four.

sourceReviewSummary: We use the Student Calendar for break dates, Digital Learning Days, conference early releases, and student return dates. We use the detailed School-Year Calendar for staff development days, semester day counts, and the 180th student day.
sourceReviewDetails: We checked the GCPS Student Calendar for break ranges, at-home Digital Learning Day guidance, K–8 conference early-release details, high school exam releases, and the January 5 return date.
We checked the detailed School-Year Calendar for January 4's teacher planning and staff development label, semester day counts, and the 180th student day on May 26.
The October 19, November 30, and April 12 return dates are the first regular school days after the published break ranges.
sourceMaintainerText: Denis Dou using official GCPS sources
